text: Vellum .s3. .amazonaws.com — a third origin, neither this SPA's nor the API's — so 'self' and https://blueprintr.io do not cover them. 2026-09-04: their absence blocked every save of a diagram containing a new image. A CSP-blocked fetch rejects with the SAME wording as a CORS-blocked one ("NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource." in Firefox, "Failed to fetch" in Chrome), so this hid behind a genuine CORS misconfiguration on the uploads bucket and survived fixing it. img-src already had *.amazonaws.com for DISPLAYING those images; connect-src never got the matching entry for transferring the bytes. Scoped to S3 rather than reusing img-src's broad *.amazonaws.com — connect-src grants read access to responses, so it earns a tighter leash. NOTE THE REGION COUPLING: eu-west-1 is pinned across this deployment; moving the bucket's region without editing this line reintroduces the bug silently. -->
